clue.text: Most injudicious — in the USA anyway

definitions.meaning: the least sensible, read as a two-word phrase
an American word meaning 'at any rate'

explanation.walkthrough: Split as two words, the answer means 'least wise', the most injudicious; as one word it is American for 'anyway'.
explanation.definitionFit: Read as one word it is an Americanism meaning at least or in any case; read as two it describes the most foolish person.

clue.text: The fellow in shelter returning for a top-coat

indicators.note: returning means the whole assembled run is read from the end back to the start
in means the fellow is placed inside the word for shelter

parts.note: lee is the sheltered side, away from the wind
a man is a fellow

explanation.surface: A man retreats under cover in search of an overcoat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns LE(MAN)E, the man inside LEE, round so it reads backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Enamel is a hard glossy paint used as the final finishing layer.

clue.text: Oriental coppers taking in tot get disheartened

indicators.note: taking in means the coins hold the next word inside them

parts.note: the sen is a small coin of Japan and other Far Eastern countries
to tot up is to add

explanation.surface: Someone sums up their small Far Eastern change and feels glum.
explanation.walkthrough: SEN is a low-value Japanese or Far Eastern coin.
explanation.definitionFit: To grow sad is to become disheartened, and the verb can be intransitive in this sense.

clue.text: Exclusively western plant

parts.note: holly is an evergreen plant

explanation.surface: A garden that grows only plants from the west.
explanation.definitionFit: Entirely or solely, so exclusively is a synonym.

clue.text: Back with little hesitation the more rigorous

parts.note: the stern is the back of a ship
er is the short sound of someone hesitating

explanation.surface: A sharp instruction to return without pausing to the stricter option.
explanation.definitionFit: Comparative of a word meaning strict and severe, so it means more rigorous.

clue.text: Poem on lad's turmoil held up to ridicule

indicators.note: turmoil means the letters of these words are thrown into disorder and rearranged

parts.note: the possessive 's gives no letter

explanation.surface: A boy's agitated verse gets him laughed at.
explanation.definitionFit: To satirise someone in mocking writing is to hold them up to ridicule.

clue.text: Dull-coloured flag say never raised

parts.note: to flag is to sag or droop
eg, for example, means say

indicators.note: raised in a down clue means the word for never is written upwards, so backwards

parts.note: ne'er is the poetic contraction of never

explanation.surface: A drab banner that is never hoisted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns NE'ER upwards into REEN; the apostrophe is ignored.
explanation.definitionFit: A muted greyish green, the colour of sage leaves, so a dull colour.

clue.text: The girl guide will give one a seat

definitions.text: The girl guide will give one a seat

parts.words: The girl guide will give one a seat
parts.note: not a Girl Guide of the youth movement but a woman who guides people to their seats in a cinema or theatre

explanation.surface: A scout leader offers someone a chair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'girl guide' suggests the youth organisation; here it is literally a girl who guides.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman employed to show patrons to their seats in a theatre or cinema.

clue.text: Measures called for when wagons carry a load

indicators.note: carry means the wagons hold the next piece inside them

parts.note: carts are wagons

explanation.surface: Weights are needed when the wagons are loaded up.
explanation.definitionFit: Units of weight for gems or of purity for gold, so measures.

clue.text: Appear in suspense about new card but not paperback

indicators.note: about means the hovering word is wrapped round the rearranged card

parts.note: to hover is to seem to hang suspended in the air

indicators.note: new means the word card is made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A card hangs in the air, and it is not a paperback.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges CARD into ARDC, which 'about' puts inside HOVER.
explanation.definitionFit: A book bound in stiff boards, the opposite of a softcover edition.

clue.text: There's a bit for everyone

parts.note: a piece is a bit

explanation.surface: A share for each person.
explanation.definitionFit: Means each or per person, so for everyone.

clue.text: Cutting down — even on fish

parts.note: level means even or flat
ling is a long fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: Felling trees evenly beside the fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Razing or flattening something to the ground is cutting it down.

clue.text: Rows within the church would be unseemly

indicators.note: within means the rows are set inside the church

parts.note: CE is the abbreviation for Church of England
oars are what one rows with

explanation.surface: Arguments inside the church would be improper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rows' looks like quarrels, but it is oars.
explanation.definitionFit: Vulgar or crude behaviour is unseemly.

clue.text: Supporters' split is the short answer

parts.note: to part is to split
ans is a short form of answer

explanation.surface: Fans divide over a curt reply.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Supporters'' stands for 'Supporters is', the apostrophe hiding the link.
explanation.definitionFit: Committed adherents of a cause or party are its supporters.

clue.text: On which a person may be entitled to use a metal pen

definitions.text: On which a person may be entitled

indicators.note: to use these letters freely means rearranging them into a new word

explanation.surface: Someone is allowed to write with a metal pen.
explanation.definitionFit: A plate bearing a person's name and title, so it is where someone is entitled.

clue.text: Rueful about restricted social worker

parts.note: re means about or concerning
pent means shut in or restricted
the ant is a social insect, a worker in a colony

explanation.surface: Sorrow over a hemmed-in welfare officer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'social worker' suggests a welfare officer; it is the ant, a social insect.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling sorry for one's sins is being contrite or regretful.

clue.text: Vetch is included in cattle-fodder sometimes

indicators.note: included in means the letters sit inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: This plant sometimes goes into cattle feed.
explanation.definitionFit: Ers is the bitter vetch, a leguminous plant.

clue.text: Before going up and down

indicators.note: going up and down says the word reads the same written upwards or downwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Prior to rising and falling.
explanation.definitionFit: A poetic word meaning prior to.

clue.text: A well-equipped resort

parts.note: not a resort with good facilities, but one literally equipped with a well or mineral spring

explanation.surface: A holiday spot with good facilities.
explanation.definitionFit: A resort town built around a mineral spring.

clue.text: A mature though unreliable layman

indicators.note: unreliable means these letters cannot be trusted to stay in order

explanation.surface: A grown-up who cannot be depended on and has no professional training.
explanation.definitionFit: A non-professional, someone outside a specialist field.

clue.text: Ostensible reason for a written introduction?

definitions.meaning: read as ..., something coming before the main writing

explanation.definitionFit: It means a false excuse, and split as pre-text it could jokingly be what precedes a piece of writing.

clue.text: Time for an article on the queen

indicators.note: on in an across clue means the article is placed after the queen

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A period for writing a piece about the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: A period of history is a span of time.

clue.text: Regret to find some err badly

indicators.note: badly means the letters are put together in the wrong order

explanation.surface: Sorrow at seeing people make poor mistakes.
explanation.definitionFit: Deep regret for wrongdoing.

clue.text: Not far short of the most perfect old city

indicators.note: not far short of means nearly all of the phrase, falling one letter short at the end

parts.note: the best means the most perfect

explanation.surface: An ancient city nearly as good as it gets.
explanation.walkthrough: THE BEST loses its final letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Ancient city of Egypt, and also of Greece.

clue.text: Foil package containing duplicated key

indicators.note: containing means the package holds the doubled key inside it

parts.note: a bale is a bound bundle or package

indicators.note: duplicated means the key is written twice

parts.note: F is a musical key

explanation.surface: Wrapping a parcel in tinfoil with a copy of a key inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Foil' looks like the metal wrapping; it is the verb 'thwart'.
explanation.definitionFit: To baffle a plan is to thwart or frustrate it.

clue.text: The rest of the afternoon

parts.note: not the remaining hours but a rest taken in the afternoon

explanation.surface: Whatever remains of the day after lunch.
explanation.definitionFit: An afternoon nap taken in hot countries.

clue.text: German and single and free

parts.note: und is German for and
one is single

explanation.surface: A German who is unattached and at liberty.
explanation.definitionFit: Unfastened or untied, so set free.

clue.text: Snappy devil having a link with conservationists

parts.note: an imp is a little devil
a tie is a link or bond
NT is the National Trust, a British heritage conservation charity

explanation.surface: An irritable rogue who is associated with green campaigners.
explanation.walkthrough: The National Trust (NT) looks after historic British houses and landscapes.
explanation.definitionFit: Irritable and short-tempered, so snappy.

clue.text: Accord respect to cook about fifty

indicators.note: about means the cooking word goes round the number

parts.note: to saute is to fry quickly, a way to cook
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Show appreciation to a chef of around fifty.
explanation.definitionFit: To honour with a formal gesture of respect.

clue.text: Favouring a merger which would mean a lot

parts.note: pro means in favour of
a fusion is a merging or union

explanation.surface: Support for a corporate merger that would be significant.
explanation.definitionFit: An abundance or great quantity.

clue.text: Registering no sound

parts.note: a ting is a light ringing sound

explanation.surface: Recording silence.
explanation.definitionFit: Observing and recording something is registering it.

clue.text: Date green conversion is to be made

indicators.note: conversion means the letters of these words are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: A date for turning something green is being produced.
explanation.definitionFit: Produced or brought into being, a synonym.
